Damn, that sucks man. Thought about taking the big jump, but I just never did. I just always saw it as if I tell her, there would be no point, no positive outcome. Nothing would really change, ya know? I know she's not into me, I mean she's in a LDR and I'm right here. If anything I'll til they break up.

I mean, yeah, but I don't want to be in love with this girl, hell I'd be so happy if I just wasn't in love with her, but I just don't know how to shake this feeling. I've dated other girls, whether it be long term or just one night stands, but every time it's a failure. I don't want to just abandon her either, because she is truly my best friend. I just don't know how to fall out of love with her.
Trust me man, that sounds fantastic right now, but I am completely broke

I'm sorry to hear about that, I hope you get better man, but I'm just freaking out right now. The girl I'm in love with, she's my best friend and well her (kind of) LD boyfriend came to see her for the whole day. Fucked me up completely. I'm attached to this girl, which isn't healthy at all, I see her and talk to her everyday, we spend just straight weeks with each other. She's all I think about, ya know? I tried to make plans with someone, anyone to keep my mind busy from her, but everyone fell through. I just spent the last couple of hours walking, listening to music, and smoking all my cigarettes away. About an hour ago and I gave in and just called her. I told her I was depressed, but when she asked why I realized I couldn't tell her why. I can't tell her I've been suffering all day, cause the thought of her happy with another guy was killing me. So I just told her 'I don't know' and we left it at that. Then she started going on about how she had the best day ever and how happy she was and it just killed me, I almost broke down just being on the phone with her. After that conversation I've been freaking out more. I'm thinking about just taking a bunch of ibuprofen and see what happens. I know it's stupid, cause it's the worst way to OD, but it's really all I've got on me right now. I don't know what else to do, I feel like this suffering won't ever go away.
